description:
Khruangbin share their memories of their early visits to First Avenue
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

While on tour in support of the revisited album, "The Universe Smiles Upon You ii," Khruangbin were in the Twin Cities to play at First Avenue in Minneapolis. During their interview with Jill Riley at The Current, the members of Khruangbin reflected on their early visits to the legendary Minneapolis music club. 

Khruangbin's 2025 release, "The Universe Smiles Upon You ii," is available on @deadoceansrecs.

author: The Current
description:
Khruangbin talk about 'The Universe Smiles Upon You ii' with The Current's Jill Riley
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Ten years ago, the Houston-based band Khruangbin gathered in a barn in rural Texas to record what became their debut album, "The Universe Smiles Upon You." A decade later, the band members reconvened in that same barn to revisit that music — sessions that resulted in a 10th-anniversary “revisited” edition of the album, which Khruangbin have dubbed "The Universe Smiles Upon You ii."

While on tour in support of the revisited album, Khruangbin were in the Twin Cities to play at First Avenue in Minneapolis. Before the show, they stopped at The Current to play selections from 'The Universe Smiles Upon You ii,' creating a sound that The Current’s Jill Riley has described as “space twang.” Watch the band's full interview with Jill Riley above. 

Khruangbin's 2025 release, "The Universe Smiles Upon You ii," is available on @deado
title: Khruangbin interview with Jill Riley at The Current
